q2_gaps: negation of a relational (kind-to-kind) generic: the instruction set defines the opaque (<Verb> <kindA> <kindB>) form for two bare-kind arguments, and defines negation separately for copular atoms (strength 0.0 on the same atom), for events (strength-0.0 And bundle) and for distributing verbal generics (rule at strength 0.0), but never says which of these applies when the relational-generic form itself is negated
notes: Both arguments are bare mass NPs, so the kind-relation route is the licensed one and Yield is licensed under the kind-level-relation open class. The whole parse pivots on fusing fresh_water as a term-of-art kind; had fresh been read as an adjectival restriction on water instead, the adjectivally-restricted-kind-subject rule would have forced a distributing rule.
